_note: Human body for children (owner request 2026-11-24). Place in the app not decided yet: no target, do not export.

jobs.name: Das Herz pumpt
jobs.subject: A cheerful child stands seen from the front with a see-through body, like a friendly picture book cutaway: a big red heart in the middle of the chest, red and blue blood vessels branch from the heart out into the arms, legs and head like the branches of a tree. Plain warm background.

jobs.name: Blut reist durch den Körper
jobs.subject: Inside a wide red blood vessel that looks like a round tunnel: many round red blood cells shaped like soft discs float along it like a stream of little boats, carrying small light blue air bubbles, a few round white blood cells among them. Seen from inside the tunnel, it curves away into the distance.

jobs.name: Das Gehirn denkt
jobs.subject: A child seen from the side draws with a crayon. Its head is see-through and shows a pink wrinkly brain; thin glowing yellow nerve lines run from the brain down the neck and the arm to the hand holding the crayon. Soft simple body outline, plain warm background.

jobs.name: Die Lunge atmet
jobs.subject: A child seen from the front blows on a dandelion. Its chest is see-through and shows two big pink lungs like soft sponges, with an air pipe that branches like an upside-down tree; light blue swirls of air flow in through the nose and down into the lungs. Plain warm background.

jobs.name: Der Weg vom Essen
jobs.subject: A child seen from the front bites into a red apple. Its tummy is see-through and shows the way of the food: a food pipe down from the mouth, a pink stomach like a pouch, and the long coiled pink intestine below it. Plain warm background.

jobs.name: Knochen halten uns
jobs.subject: A happy child jumps with arms and legs spread wide. Its body is see-through like a friendly x-ray and shows white bones: the round skull, the spine, the ribs, the arm bones, the hand bones, the leg bones and the foot bones. Plain light blue background.

jobs.name: Muskeln bewegen uns
jobs.subject: A child lifts a toy bucket full of sand with one arm bent. The arm is see-through and shows the red muscle on the upper arm, bulging as it pulls the white arm bones. The child's legs are see-through too and show strong red leg muscles. Sandpit and sunny garden behind.

jobs.name: Wie das Auge sieht
jobs.subject: A child looks at a colourful butterfly on a flower. Soft yellow beams of light travel from the butterfly into the child's big eye; the child's head is see-through and shows a line running from the back of the eye to the pink brain. Seen from the side. Garden behind.

jobs.name: Zähne kauen
jobs.subject: A child brushes its teeth in front of a bathroom mirror with a big smile showing white teeth. Beside it stands one big tooth cut in half like in a picture book: the white crown on top, the pink gum and the long roots below. Cosy bathroom with a cup and a towel.

jobs.name: Die Abwehr hilft
jobs.subject: Inside a body next to a small cut on a knee: friendly round white blood cells like little helpers catch small green germ blobs, while red blood cells build a soft red scab over the cut. Seen close up like a picture book cutaway, with the edge of a plaster visible at the top.
